data.narrative:
The Bot Company is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing firm that has raised approximately $550M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine comparable companies—one public (277810.KQ) and eight private entities in the same sector and stage, including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $550M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $1.0B. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations of $1.6B, $1.8B, and $2.0B, producing a median of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. The stage-progression method is conservative relative to peer benchmarks, likely because the $550M raised figure may understate recent market pricing.

Triangulating both methods yields a valuation range of $888M to $2.0B, with a median of $1.4B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given that comparable Series B robotics companies cluster tightly between $1.6B and $2.0B. The primary uncertainty is whether recent fundraising rounds among peers reflect actual operational traction or market exuberance in frontier tech. Resolution of this ambiguity and clarification of The Bot Company's revenue or deployment metrics would narrow the range materially.
